coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball both directories company-by-company into individual candidate records with own-site and app-store URLs; this is the cheapest route to the next 20-40 actors in the cell.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidate URLs through the deterministic liveness pass; treat 403/timeout as bot-defended and retry with a headless browser before marking anything dead.

brief: Kosovo's payments layer is small, young and unusually well-signposted: the Central Bank (BQK) publishes a dated master list of licensed institutions that is the definitive actor register for PIs, EMIs and non-bank financial institutions, while the FIKS fintech cluster and the ICK incubator act as the two best pointer directories for firms that are not yet licensed. The commercially active set splits into diaspora-corridor wallet/remittance players (Swinto, OneFor, Paysera as the first EMI) and an incumbent physical remittance layer (Unioni Financiar Prishtinë for Western Union, Moneta and AK-Invest for MoneyGram) — nearly all of whom publicise launches and partnerships through Albanian-language sponsored media, making gazetaexpress.com, koha.net, telegrafi.com and the Swiss diaspora outlet albinfo.ch high-yield partnership-signal feeds. Vendor and infrastructure detail is thinner locally and is best recovered from English payments trade press plus donor programme documents (IFC/SECO with BQK on the payment-services law and open banking). The clearest weaknesses are Serbian-language and Serb-majority-municipality coverage, telecom/post payment channels, and public procurement, all of which should be closed before this cell is considered complete.
